.splsda.validation

Source: R/sPLS.DA_functions.R
dot-splsda.validation.Rd

Internal. Adapts the cross-validation scheme to the size of the smallest class. Asking for more folds than the samples available in a class produces empty folds, and mixOmics would either fail or silently return an over-optimistic error rate.

.splsda.validation(Y, validation = "Mfold", folds = 5, nrepeat = 10)

Arguments

Y

Factor of the classes.

validation

String indicating the validation scheme ('Mfold' or 'loo').

folds

Number of folds.

nrepeat

Number of repeats of the cross-validation.

Value

A list with the elements validation, folds and nrepeat.
